summary: Heaps Normal is a Canberra-born, Sydney-based independent non-alcoholic beer brand sold through major retailers and pubs, now in the UK and US. CFO Damien Williams (ex-Culture Amp) featured on The CFO Track podcast in November 2026, and CEO Andy Miller has said the company is exploring a Series B. AFR reported in January 2026 that it is meeting global investors and planning offshore manufacturing.

hooks.text: Damien's CFO Track episode and his tech-to-physical-product move: speak to scaling finance foundations in a product business.
Capital raise plus offshore manufacturing and UK/US expansion: close quality and investor reporting matter more.
Retail and pub channels plus export supply mean payout, inventory and FX reconciliation load.
